en: The Triplet on the Low (Hīnattika), the Dyad on the Root (Hetuduka)

Dependent on a low, rootless state, a not-low, non-root state arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are thirteen; under object condition nine … pe … under result condition eight … pe … under non-disappearance condition thirteen.

Dependent on a low, rootless state, a not-medium, non-root state arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are nine … pe … under result condition six … pe … under non-disappearance condition nine.
